ai_break_conflict: Courted AS the conflict with the frozen house call AI-BREAK|2027-12-31 @ p=0.45, not averaged away. Management's own and ONLY quantification: the data center/HPC/AI end market was 'approximately 15% of our 2024 net sales and is our fastest-growing sector' (Form 10). No update published; FY25/FY26 AI share is UNVERIFIABLE. DOES THE ENTRY REQUIRE THE CYCLE HOLDING? Partially, and more than 15% suggests - AI is ~15% of the base but a disproportionate share of the GROWTH, and the 10-K ties both segments' volume gains to advanced nodes, advanced packaging and thermal management. Consumables economics soften a downturn (per-wafer materials, not equipment), but at ~33.6x forward the multiple carries cycle optimism regardless of mix. DOES THE DE-RATE ALREADY PRICE THE BREAK? NO. Peak multiple was ~44x forward; today's ~33.6x is normalisation off an extreme, not the ~22-24x a genuine capex break would impose. Do NOT treat this de-rate as AI-break protection.
